title: Driver Services Agreement Terms: Ending the Agreement, Earnings on Exit and Fraud Payout Holds
content:
These terms of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product cover a Wayfare driver ending the agreement and the effect of deactivations on earnings payouts.

**1. The driver's right to end the agreement.** A driver may end the agreement at any time while it is active or on hold; it is the driver's own decision and takes effect at once, and no reapplication wait applies.

**2. Earnings already posted.** Ending the agreement does not cancel earnings already posted: the earnings account pays out its balance before it closes.

**3. Deactivation and payouts.** A fraud deactivation also places the driver's earnings payouts on hold; other deactivations leave payouts running.

| Event | Effect on the agreement | Effect on earnings payouts |
|---|---|---|
| driver ends an active or on-hold agreement | closed at once, no reapplication wait | balance paid out before the earnings account closes |
| deactivation for fraud | deactivated | payouts placed on hold |
| any other deactivation | deactivated | payouts keep running |

Hypothetical reading: a driver on a temporary cancellation hold who ends the agreement today has it closed today, and may sign a new agreement without a reapplication wait.
